name: Valdemoro (Spain)
description: White field with a broad diagonal band of green and red from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valdemoro (a tower on blue and a figure, with the words VAL DE MORO).
history: Municipal flag of Valdemoro; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
